thread:
marta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we promised a short remediation plan and owners for streaming/chat timeouts & partial responses. Can we list owners + timelines here?
kevin: I can own the reconnect/backoff code changes. Plan: audit current handler, add exponential backoff + jitter, and add unit tests. ETA: Wed EOD. :thumbsup:
sophia: I'll take timeouts & config defaults (server + client SDK) and add a synthetic streaming test to CI. ETA: Fri.
david: I will run a log sweep for recurring partial-response patterns and summarize patterns by region and model. Will share query and initial results today.
kevin: preliminary note — some clients hit our 30s socket timeout while KV cache warm-ups happen; need to consider prefix caching interaction.
marta: Good. Let's make concrete action items here: A1: reconnect/backoff (kevin) Wed EOD. A2: timeout defaults + synthetic tests (sophia) Fri. A3: log analysis + pattern report (david) EOD today. A4: rollout plan + canary (marta) next Tue.
kevin: I'll open a tracking PR and link infra ticket. PR will include a small template for backoff params.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/812 — still draft.
david: quick log snippet I ran against prod-events (last 48h):
```
2026-03-17T10:12:05Z svc=streaming instance=a3 partial_resp=true model=gpt-3.8 seq_len=256 latency_ms=1200
2026-03-17T12:44:11Z svc=streaming instance=a7 partial_resp=true region=eu latency_ms=980
2026-03-18T01:05:23Z svc=streaming instance=b1 partial_resp=true model=gpt-3.8 kv_miss=true
```
david: Pattern: spikes cluster near autoscale events and KV cache misses. Will annotate counts by instance and region.
sophia: For synthetic test I'll simulate short prefix + long continuation to exercise KV warm-up and reassemble streaming frames. Example test harness command: `./tools/sim_stream --model gpt-3.8 --prefix-length 40 --duration 10s`
marta: Good call. For rollout: please plan a canary (10% traffic) on Dedicated pools and a feature-flagged runtime param so we can disable quickly.
kevin: noted. Will add feature flag and a metric (reconnect_rate) to the PR. Also adding jitter defaults: base=200ms, max=5s.
sophia: I'll add a CI job that runs the sim_stream harness nightly against canary servers. Also adding alert when partial_response_rate > 0.5% for >10m.
david: Uploaded initial pattern doc to the incidents folder: https://drive.redwood/incident/streaming-patterns-1825 (contains distribution plots).
marta: Ownership check: kevin, sophia, david confirmed. I'll own canary and rollout schedule. Can we post weekly check-ins until metrics stabilize?
kevin: yes. I'll post updates in #eng-runtime every deploy.
sophia: Added ticket INC-2349 for synthetic tests, and INC-2350 for timeout defaults.
incidents-bot: Reminder set — follow-up in 48h for A1/A3 results.
david: Quick ETA update — pattern report done, but I want one more correlation with autoscaler logs. Expect final by 2pm PST.
kevin: Backoff PR ready for review, added unit tests and a test harness stub. Requesting review from @sophia and @marta.
sophia: Reviewing now. Left one comment on jitter edge-case.
marta: After code review and tests pass, let's canary next Tue on saturn cluster. If partial_response_rate drops >60% then promote.
kevin: Can we add a temporary server-side metric `streaming.partial_retries`? It's cheap and will help correlate.
david: I'll add correlations in the dashboard (by instance and region) once metrics exist.
sophia: Deployed synthetic canary last night (saturn-1). Observed a 45% reduction in partials for the small sample — promising but small n.
marta: Excellent. Keep the canary running and do not promote yet — need bigger sample. Weekly check-in scheduled. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: assigning owners in the ticket tracker now (INC-2345). Will update PR link when ready.
david: Final note — recurring pattern seems tied to warmup latencies when autoscaler launches cold instances. Long-term we should pre-warm KV cache or prioritize warm instances for streaming. Added as long-term A5.
marta: A5 (long-term pre-warm KV + routing preference) — owners TBD, will discuss in architecture sync next week.
kevin: Thanks all — I'll post a short status update after code review completes.
sophia: ping me if you want pairing on the synthetic harness today.
marta: Thanks team. Closing loop here for now — we will update this thread with timestamps from PRs and canary metrics. :white_check_mark:
